name: WhisperLv3-FT (European Portuguese)
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.543 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-05-09. Evidence caveat: the CAMOES paper's own EP-X recipe scores 12.5 WER vs this model's 16.7, and this checkpoint is much worse than base on out-of-domain Portuguese (AAP 101.4 vs 29.9).

benchmarks.name: CAMOES EP Avg. WER %
benchmarks.config: Card 'Results on the CAMOES benchmark' table, row 'This model (WhisperLv3, fine-tuned)' 16.7 vs row 'Baseline: original Whisper large-v3, no fine-tuning' 24.6. Equal-weight average over 5 EP domains, CAMOES normaliser. CAVEAT: loses badly on African/Asian Portuguese (AAP 101.4 vs 29.9) and Brazilian Portuguese (BP 28.2 vs 25.8); EP-X variant of the same recipe scores 12.5.
